description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'NodeRuntime' class, which manages the core runtime logic for the ai.openclaw.app Android application. It handles gateway connections, session management, chat, voice, device services, and UI interactions, coordinating various components and network communications within the app.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class managing network sessions, device services, UI components, and interactions within the Android app for the OpenClaw platform.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPrompt
classes.description: Data class representing a prompt to trust a specific gateway's TLS fingerprint.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Represents the payload structure for updating the home canvas UI.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Represents individual agent cards in the home canvas UI.

methods.name: resolveNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Generates session key based on device ID and optional agent ID.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth
methods.description: Resolves the authentication details to connect to a gateway, using explicit or stored credentials.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts a TLS fingerprint trust prompt and initiates connection.

methods.name: declineGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines the TLS fingerprint trust prompt.

methods.name: loadStoredRoleDeviceToken
methods.description: Loads stored device token for a specific role.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes gateway events and updates the runtime state accordingly.
